_help: casServerUrl: your CAS server, e.g. your 3DPassport address ending in /3dpassport. Empty = no sign-in.
serviceUrls: extra addresses people use to reach this laptop, e.g. http://novaceris-demo.mycompany.com:8080 (your own URL). localhost and the computer name are added on their own.
allowedUsers: CAS user names allowed in, e.g. ["aki61"]. Empty = anyone who signs in to CAS.
sessionHours: how long a sign-in lasts. Restarting the server signs everyone out.
skipForLocalhost: true = your own browser on http://localhost skips sign-in (also keeps the demo working inside a 3DDashboard).
